description: A full bucket lets the start of a burst through at the offered rate, then admission flattens to the refill rate. Idle time refills the bucket, capped at its capacity.
Offered load steps from below to above the refill rate. Below it every call is admitted and the bucket stays full; above it the bucket drains and admission caps at the refill rate.

Bursts of 100 calls against a 10-token bucket: only the stored tokens plus what refills during the burst get through, so most of each burst is rejected although the average load equals the refill rate.
The same bursts against a 100-token bucket: the idle time between bursts refills it, so every burst is absorbed in full while the long-run admitted rate still matches the refill rate.
setRefillRate changes the rate under a steady 200 rps load: admission follows the lower of the offered and refill rates, and the bucket's stored tokens carry across each change.
setCapacity resizes the bucket between bursts: shrinking clamps the stored tokens at once, growing lets them refill gradually (no phantom tokens), and each burst gets through in proportion.
